input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law and Section 28.2 confers exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County, with irrevocable submission to personal jurisdiction and a waiver of venue/forum objections. This matches the preferred position exactly. No arbitration provision appears anywhere in the document (search for "arbitration" returned nothing), so there is no foreign-seated arbitration concern. The carve-out in 28.2 permitting temporary injunctive relief in another court, and the pre-suit executive escalation in 28.3 (which expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings), are mutual and do not displace the New York forum. No redline needed.
